criteria.note: Reads via the WARP-0603 seam and drafts a warp.spec/v1 (draft, standalone) bound to the resolved repo with AC1 reproduction, no-regression ACn, and the source ticket linked; feeds the existing intake procedure.
Reuses WARP-0601 resolve_repo (spy-proven, not reimplemented); refuses missing/unknown/ambiguous routing by name (IntakeError), never a default; could not sneak a misroute.

The pure Jira mapping (_jira_issue_to_item + _jira_text ADF flatten) survived every adversarial fixture (plain/ADF/missing/malformed descriptions, odd label/component shapes, custom fields preserved) without crashing.

JiraCloudAdapter is honestly reference-wired; token from a secrets ref, fails closed with no token, no raw credential, no network in the pure/gate paths; epic/child raise by name as a correct W4 boundary.
Non-tautology + valid-draft: the rendered draft validates with the real check_spec; mutation matrix (hardcode repo -> 4 red, neuter ADF flatten -> 1 red, remove token guard -> 1 red) proves teeth.

findings.text: Full independent adversarial review at 4223f0b returned pass_with_notes, 0 blocking, confirming all 5 ACs (routing/refusal spy-verified, ADF mapping robust, secrets fail-closed, mutation teeth). It raised ONE should-fix: a front-matter injection - the untrusted ticket title was emitted verbatim into the rendered YAML, so newlines could inject a front-matter key line (the reviewer hijacked id/schema and still passed check_spec via the shallow last-wins parser). It also noted a pre-existing out-of-scope config filename drift (PLAN-0006 prose says trackers.yaml, WARP-0601 ships trackers.json).

The injection was FIXED in this commit (58ad5ec): _fm_safe collapses every control character (ord < 32) and, via a second split()/join pass, every Unicode line separator (U+2028/U+2029/U+0085) to single spaces, applied to the title at the draft boundary and to every value emitted into front matter, so ticket content can only be a scalar value, never a structural key. A scoped independent re-review bound to 58ad5ec returned PASS with zero blocking: the delta is exactly the fix + its test with the intake logic, the Jira mapping, and JiraCloudAdapter byte-unchanged; it tried 10 attack families (title/body/labels/components/owner/tab/Unicode-line-separators and injections of id/schema/owner/status/plan/work/protected_paths/human_approval/acceptance_criteria) and NONE injected a structural key or escalated any field; teeth confirmed (neutering _fm_safe turns the assertion red and makes the parser reject the duplicate key); no over-mangle of legitimate content; gate GREEN (selftest 1176 passed, 0 failed) with no regression; capabilities.yaml copies byte-identical. The config filename drift is accepted as out of scope (W4 takes the config as an argument and never reads it from disk).

Operational: built in-session by a single writer; the ticket report body is intentionally left unsanitized as human-readable text after the closing front-matter fence (a fenced fake-spec in the body cannot hijack the front matter, confirmed). No template twin (not a validate/policy_check load dependency). Verified GREEN in a clean detached worktree before and after the fix.

summary: W4 of PLAN-0006 (Jira intake) is correct. Two independent adversarial reviews (a full pass on 4223f0b, a scoped re-review bound to this shipped commit 58ad5ec) both PASS with 0 blocking. An external ticket becomes a routing-resolved warp.spec/v1 draft: read through the WARP-0603 seam, repo resolved with the reused WARP-0601 resolver (refused by name if unroutable, never guessed), the report captured as the AC1 reproduction and the ticket linked, rendered as a spec the real validator accepts. The risky Jira field mapping is pure and gate-tested; the live JiraCloudAdapter is honestly reference-wired (token from a secrets ref, fails closed, not gate-run). A front-matter injection found by review (untrusted title becoming structural front matter) was fixed with control-character and Unicode-line-separator sanitization at every front-matter emission and re-verified against 10 attack families. Gate GREEN (selftest 1176 passed, 0 failed), no regression, no protected path. proof_digest via validate.py.
